description.value: Paris Baguette is a Korean-origin international bakery café chain known for freshly baked pastries, custom celebration cakes, and café beverages. The Alberni Street location sits in Vancouver's dense West End neighbourhood, a short ride from Stanley Park and the seawall cycling routes. Cyclists will find a broad grab-and-go selection of sandwiches, wraps, donuts, and sweet pastries alongside hot and iced drinks.
